name: Valentine Kiss: Birthdays 2
original_name: バレンタインキッス ～バースデイズ２～
source:
Valentine Kiss is a dating simulation game, very similar to Birthdays, only instead of "conquering" a girl as a birthday present, the goal here is to "score" on Valentine's Day

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/valentine-kiss]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
《情人节之吻》是一款约会模拟游戏，和生日很相似，只不过不是“征服”女孩作为生日礼物，而是在情人节“得分”

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/valentine-kiss]Mobygames[/url]]
